exposure: changes in z-score of head circumference (HC) at birth, postmenstrual age (PMA) 35 weeks, and 4 and 18 months corrected age (CA)
HC growth between PMA 35 weeks and 4 months CA
Weight and length increases between birth and 18 months CA
cohort: The study included 122 very preterm infants born at <32 weeks' gestation or weighing <1500 g.
finding: Head circumference at 4 months corrected age and head growth spurt between PMA 35 weeks and 4 months CA showed a positive correlation with Bayley-III scores in appropriate-for-gestational-age infants (AGAs), while only birthweight's z-score was associated with improved neurodevelopmental outcomes in small-for-gestational-age infants (SGAs).
